example: The milk is in the fridge.

Suitable for ages 11–12, natural proportions, not babyish. One coherent scene, square composition, main subject clear at thumbnail size, light breathing room around the subject. No photorealism, no 3D, no vector-flat rendering.
Constraints: absolutely no letters, readable text, words, numbers, captions, Vietnamese meanings, definitions, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative border or speech bubbles.
